title: Exploring Vision-Language Alignment under Subtle Contradictions

contributions.purpose: 构建可控文本可见度的矛盾文本扰动评测协议
contributions.mechanism: COCO2017 采样 5000 图,各生成 Original/Faint(alpha 混合近隐形)/Visible 三条件共 15000 点,Qwen2.5-VL-7B 免微调测计数/检测/场景描述
contributions.evaluation: 三任务多指标(计数 Acc/MAE、检测 Acc、场景 recall/color/spurious/#objects)
contributions.domain: 视觉-语言模型鲁棒性/对抗
contributions.source_quote: we systematically introduce faintly embedded and clearly visible contradictory text into a large-scale dataset, examining its effects on object counting, object detection, and scene description under varying text visibility.

contributions.purpose: 揭示计数任务对矛盾文本高度脆弱
contributions.mechanism: 对比三条件计数精度与 MAE
contributions.source_quote: counting accuracy suffers significantly in the presence of adversarial textual perturbations

contributions.purpose: 揭示检测稳健、描述仅轻微收窄的任务差异
contributions.mechanism: 猫检测精度、场景 recall/color/spurious/objects 跨条件对比
contributions.evaluation: 猫检测恒 0.954;color 0.976→0.979 不变;recall 0.555→0.539;spurious 6.67→5.13、objects 2.30→2.12(描述更保守)
contributions.source_quote: object detection remains robust and scene descriptions exhibit only minor shifts under faint disruptions.

notes: 实证 finding,方法清晰、数字完整。局限:单模型(Qwen2.5-VL-7B)、单数据集(COCO 5000)、单一合成扰动;无统计显著性检验(checklist Q7=No);无独立 Limitations 节(Q2=No)。质量/披露红旗:checklist Q5 观察到的 AI 局限用词轻佻——"It's been really, really great. The limit is only the amount of available compute :)";拒绝开源代码,理由"open-sourcing the code would make it much easier to reverse-engineer the system that wrote the paper"(护住生成系统而非科学复现,破坏开放性)。checklist:假设/设计/分析均 [D](人类零反馈),写作 [C];声称由不知情人类复现得同样结果。
